description: Compare sel0 AlphaFold active-site geometry with PsSelO crystal structure 6EAC
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O13890-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
        rows.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),res=ln[17:20].strip(),num=int(ln[22:26]),
                         x=float(ln[30:38]),y=float(ln[38:46]),z=float(ln[46:54]),b=float(ln[60:66])))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("AF model residues",A['num'].min(),"-",A['num'].max(),"global pLDDT 95.75")
plddt=A.drop_duplicates('num').set_index('num')['b']

def at(df,n,a):
    s=df[(df['num']==n)&(df['name']==a)]
    return s[['x','y','z']].values[0]
def dist(a,b): return round(float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(a)-np.array(b))),2)

SEL0={'D121':('ASP','OD2'),'R123':('ARG','NH2'),'K144':('LYS','NZ'),'D156':('ASP','OD2'),
      'E167':('GLU','OE1'),'R208':('ARG','NH2'),'R215':('ARG','NH2'),
      'D287':('ASP','OD2'),'N288':('ASN','OD1'),'D297':('ASP','OD2')}
print("\nsel0 AlphaFold: residue identity and pLDDT at mapped catalytic positions")
for k,(rn,an) in SEL0.items():
    n=int(k[1:]); obs=A[A['num']==n]['res'].iloc[0]
    print(f"  {k}: model residue {obs} (expected {rn}), pLDDT {plddt[n]:.1f}  {'OK' if obs==rn else 'MISMATCH'}")

pairs=[('K144','E167'),('K144','D287'),('K144','D297'),('D287','N288'),('N288','D297'),
       ('K144','D156'),('D121','K144'),('R208','D287'),('R215','D287'),('D121','D297'),('R123','D297')]
m={'D121':'D91','R123':'R93','K144':'K113','D156':'D125','E167':'E136','R208':'R176','R215':'R183',
   'D287':'D252','N288':'N253','D297':'D262'}
PSat={'D91':'OD2','R93':'NH2','K113':'NZ','D125':'OD2','E136':'OE1','R176':'NH2','R183':'NH2',
      'D252':'OD2','N253':'OD1','D262':'OD2'}

cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6EAC.cif",timeout=180).text
lines=cif.split("\n"); cols=[];start=None
for i,ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(ln.strip().split(".")[1])
    elif cols and not ln.startswith("_"): start=i;break
atoms=[f for ln in lines[start:] if not ln.startswith("#") and ln.strip() for f in [ln.split()] if len(f)==len(cols)]
C=pd.DataFrame(atoms,columns=cols); C=C[C['auth_asym_id']=='A'].copy()
C['num']=C['auth_seq_id'].astype(int); C['name']=C['auth_atom_id']; C['res']=C['auth_comp_id']
C['x']=C['Cartn_x'].astype(float); C['y']=C['Cartn_y'].astype(float); C['z']=C['Cartn_z'].astype(float)

sel0d={p:dist(at(A,int(p[0][1:]),SEL0[p[0]][1]), at(A,int(p[1][1:]),SEL0[p[1]][1])) for p in pairs}
psd={p:dist(at(C,int(m[p[0]][1:]),PSat[m[p[0]]]), at(C,int(m[p[1]][1:]),PSat[m[p[1]]])) for p in pairs}
cmp=pd.DataFrame({"sel0_pair":[f"{a}-{b}" for a,b in pairs],
                  "PsSelO_pair":[f"{m[a]}-{m[b]}" for a,b in pairs],
                  "sel0_AF_A":[sel0d[p] for p in pairs],
                  "PsSelO_6EAC_A":[psd[p] for p in pairs]})
cmp["delta_A"]=(cmp.sel0_AF_A-cmp.PsSelO_6EAC_A).round(2)
print("\nActive-site inter-residue distances (side-chain tip atoms):")
print(cmp.to_string(index=False))
r=np.corrcoef(cmp.sel0_AF_A,cmp.PsSelO_6EAC_A)[0,1]
print(f"\nPearson r = {r:.3f}   median |delta| = {cmp.delta_A.abs().median():.2f} A   max |delta| = {cmp.delta_A.abs().max():.2f} A")
cmp.to_csv("/tmp/cmp.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(cmp.PsSelO_6EAC_A,cmp.sel0_AF_A,c="#1565C0",s=60,zorder=3)
lim=[0,cmp[['sel0_AF_A','PsSelO_6EAC_A']].values.max()+2]
ax.plot(lim,lim,ls='--',c='grey',zorder=1)
for _,row in cmp.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(row.sel0_pair,(row.PsSelO_6EAC_A,row.sel0_AF_A),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,-2),textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_xlabel("PsSelO crystal 6EAC, distance (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("sel0 AlphaFold model, distance (A)")
ax.set_title(f"Active-site geometry is superimposable\nPearson r = {r:.3f}, median offset {cmp.delta_A.abs().median():.2f} A",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(lim); ax.set_ylim(lim)
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(plddt.index,plddt.values,lw=0.8,c="#455A64")
for k in SEL0:
    n=int(k[1:]); ax.scatter([n],[plddt[n]],c="#C62828",zorder=5,s=26)
ax.annotate("catalytic residues (red)",(300,55),fontsize=8,color="#C62828")
ax.axhline(90,ls=':',c='grey'); ax.axhline(70,ls=':',c='grey')
ax.set_xlabel("sel0 residue number"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,105)
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence, sel0 (O13890), mean pLDDT 95.8",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
